Q3 Planning — Product / Engineering / Ops Sync

Meeting date: 27 August 2026  ·  Scope lock target: Friday  ·  Exec review: Monday

  • Priya — PM
  • Marcus — Eng Lead
  • Jenna — Ops
  • Dan — Design
  • Sara — VP Product
Task: Summarize the meeting transcript as bullet points covering the key decisions and points, plus the next steps and action items.

Key Decisions & Points

Reconciliation revamp — build, not buy

  • Current engine fails on multi-currency batches: 3 incidents this quarter, reconciliation support tickets up 40% QoQ.
  • In-house rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, including migration of the FX rounding module, plus 2 weeks of Karim's time (platform) for ledger integration.
  • Vendor options rejected:
    • Recur — $180K/year at current volume.
    • LedgerFlow — $140K/year but doesn't support jurisdiction-specific tax codes.
    • Either option still needs ~3 engineer-weeks of integration work.
  • Decision: build in-house, and make reconciliation the Q3 anchor project.

Mobile receipt capture — ship v1 without bulk-select

  • Design flows are complete; prototype tested with 6 users.
  • Two findings from testing: users want bulk-select before upload, and the OCR confidence indicator needs to be far more prominent.
  • Bulk-select is out of scope and would add roughly a sprint; eng capacity is already committed to reconciliation, so adding it would force a descope elsewhere.
  • Decision: v1 ships without bulk-select; it goes on the roadmap as a fast-follow. OCR indicator prominence stays in scope.

Vendor payout SLA — pending trade-off analysis

  • Finance wants a 48-hour payout guarantee from invoice approval; current p95 is 71 hours.
  • Two bottlenecks: manual approval routing (Ops) and the 12-hour ACH send-job batching window (Eng).
  • Proposed fix: cut the ACH batch window from 12h to 4h and add a second approver on the west-coast shift — projected to hit 48h p95 by mid-Q3.
  • Cost: ~half a sprint of eng time plus SRE sign-off; more ACH files per day means more monitoring overhead.
  • Decision: no commitment yet. Proceed if SRE confirms the monitoring load is manageable; otherwise fall back to intermediate SLA targets.

Other items

  • Audit-log retention update is confirmed pushed to Q4 (agreed with Legal).
  • Internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew — no change in ownership or scope.
  • HR flagged a spike in bug-bash burnout in engineering; a lightweight rotating on-call proposal was requested.

Next Steps & Action Items
